start.text: (Six, Spider-Man T-shirt, standing very still by the pillar the way children do when they have decided not to cry and are losing.) Amma was here. Then she was... here. She's not here.

choices.text: Come. Let's find the man in the yellow vest.
Where did you last see your amma?

guard.text: (He takes two fingers of your hand, not the whole hand. Follows.)

mother.text: Token. She was buying token. The machine was angry. (He points at nothing, then at the queue.) I'll come with you.

leave.text: (He looks at the pillar. The pillar has a garland. He counts the marigolds.)

following.text: (He holds on tighter. 'Is it that one?' he asks about every adult.)
